description_en: Queries the resources of clusters within zones of a region

kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-available-resource --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-k --charge-type PostPaid --accept-language zh-CN --db-cluster-version 3.0 --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAvailableResource

parameters.help_en:
